name: Emmanuel Konan
headline: Cybersecurity Engineer
summary: IT/IoT/OT cybersecurity engineer, I work on risk analysis, security audits, industrial systems and embedded security. My career has led me to work across several sectors, notably energy, finance and the public sector, on both technical and cyber risk management issues.

experience.summary: Cybersecurity consultant and auditor working across public/administrative organizations, financial institutions, energy companies and IT/software companies, covering risk management, technical audits, industrial cybersecurity and compliance.
bullets: Lead [EBIOS-RM](https://cyber.gouv.fr/publications/ebios-risk-manager-method) risk analyses.
Perform audits covering architecture, organization and governance.
Conduct internal ISO/IEC 27001 audits.
Support clients on regulatory compliance (GDPR, NIS, AI Act).
Participate in the preparation and facilitation of cybersecurity crisis exercises.
Design and deliver cybersecurity training to client companies, covering technical, governance and awareness topics for both expert and non-expert audiences.
Lead the firm's AI adoption initiative, identifying use cases and supporting their secure integration into consulting activities.
Act as cybersecurity referent for connected devices at [Enedis](https://www.enedis.fr/).
Define security requirements and conduct qualification and audits of industrial, embedded and connected equipment.
Integrate post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms into environments with limited compute and storage resources.

experience.summary: Within a multidisciplinary cybersecurity team, I worked on the security of embedded systems, smart metering and critical infrastructure.
bullets: Assessed security risks and threat models related to security modules embedded in industrial systems.
Analyzed defense-in-depth architectures, hardware security (CPU, memory, buses) and potential vulnerabilities.
Conducted research on cryptographic mechanisms, SSH protocols (RFC 4250-4254), PLC and ISO/IEC 7816 smart-card standards.
Performed vulnerability research and penetration-testing activities on embedded environments.
Modified the OpenSSH client in C for custom security testing and information gathering.
Developed Python and Bash scripts to automate security testing and analysis.

experience.summary: Within Enedis' B2B division, my work focused on reducing non-technical losses and fighting electricity fraud.
bullets: Performed data mining and consumption analysis to identify potential fraud and abnormal electricity usage.
Automated monthly reporting and KPIs using VBA, improving performance monitoring.
Managed a national project introducing a new feature within the electricity distribution network.
Conducted security and compliance assessments of internal business tools ([DPIA](https://www.cnil.fr/fr/RGPD-analyse-impact-protection-des-donnees-aipd)).
Supported the development of Enedis' B2B strategic plan and internal awareness initiatives.
Completed a field immersion with operational technicians, gaining practical knowledge of electricity distribution, non-technical losses and the French energy market.
